summary: Claims specialist with about 10 years in insurance, focused on automobile property and liability claims, including first and third-party auto liability, bodily injury, total loss and subrogation work. Experienced in evaluating evidence, interviewing claimants and witnesses, analyzing repair estimates, and negotiating settlements, and has testified at criminal proceedings. Also brings tax examination experience processing amended returns at high volume with near-perfect accuracy, plus small-business management with bookkeeping, reconciliation, inventory and customer account responsibilities. Proficient in Excel, Access and database tools, and has trained new claim staff.
